name: STAR Orbit — low-precision geocentric Moon position
summary: Geocentric Moon position for 1950-2050 from the Astronomical Almanac series; measured within 0.36 deg and 1200 km of JPL DE440 over 2002 dates, with the same envelope against astropy and PyEphem.
reference: Vallado, Fundamentals of Astrodynamics and Applications, Example 5-3 (Moon position vector): 1994 April 28, 0h TDB -> (-134240.626, -311571.590, -126693.785) km, mean equator and equinox of date
reference_observed: each component within 3.6e-4 km of the printed values

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: km and degrees; frame = mean equator and equinox of date, stated in docstring and README
review.G-06: no external data at run time; cross-check uses JPL DE440 (de440s.bsp) through SPICE, astropy and PyEphem
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for invalid input and for dates outside the stated validity; no iteration
